## Description
Summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / UI / UX refinement

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] Vitest unit tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Client & server build successfully (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Repository size remains under 10 MB limit (`git count-objects -vH`)
